meta.purpose: P7833: add Energy Transfer's binding open season notice as a second ref on Status, Length, Diameter, Location and Start

verifications.note: Energy Transfer's binding open season notice for the South Mississippi Project, a four page PDF posted October 28, 2026 and linked from Florida Gas Transmission notice 74540. It names a receipt point in Richland Parish, Louisiana, and a new delivery point in the George County, Mississippi, area. It describes about 215 miles of either 42-inch or 36-inch pipe, says the company will seek FERC approval and has binding commitments from anchor shippers, and expects service on or before March 1, 2030. Page 1 carries a map of the project.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Status stays proposed. The company's own binding open season notice of October 28, 2026 is added beside the news story. It says the company will decide whether to build after bids close on November 25, 2026.
